rules: Each colony has exactly one active weight model at a time.
The active model must come from the six-model approved bank until a later audited bank revision.
Seed farms remain permanently linked capability roots and are never replaced by the model.
Different colonies may select different models; sharing a G0 model does not merge colony lineage.
Every colony keeps independent memory, adapter lineage and generation head.
A model switch is a versioned migration, never an overwrite.
Cross-colony learning enters only through validated GOLD/RED lessons.
AFAH is a separate seventh lineage and is never selected as a colony model.
anti_regression: HF private head verification before recall
older generation cannot auto-replace newer head
